title: Feature design doc
description: One gameplay feature, decomposed into the story -> feature -> shots -> rules/mode -> presentation layers. See design/README.md for the workflow this schema supports.

id.description: Kebab/snake-case identifier, must match the filename (without .yaml).

status.description: Where this feature is in the workflow (design/README.md step 2-8). This is the tracking mechanism - always visible at a glance across all feature files.

phase.description: Optional cross-reference to a plans/resumption-roadmap.md phase, e.g. 'Phase 3'.

story.description: The narrative layer. Can be left as TBD while a feature is still mechanic-first - never blocks progress through the other layers.

hook.description: One-line narrative hook, or an explicit 'TBD - needs a narrative pass' if not yet designed.

beats.description: Optional list of narrative beats this feature expresses, in order.

shots.description: Physical playfield elements involved. Each `ref` must name a real switch, coil, or light already defined in machinefolder/config/hardware-*.yaml - this doc never re-specifies hardware, only points at it. Checked by tests/test_design_docs.py.

ref.description: Exact switch/coil/light name from hardware-switches.yaml, hardware-coils.yaml, or hardware-leds.yaml.

role.description: What this hardware element does for this feature, e.g. 'primary shot switch', 'feedback LED', 'reset coil'.

mode.description: The MPF mode name that will (or does) live under machinefolder/modes/<name>/.

scoring.description: Freeform scoring notes - exact values are usually still TBD at design time.

presentation.description: Display/audio treatment. Placeholder notes are fine before Phase 4 (display/audio) work starts.

notes.description: Freeform - open questions, gaps found while designing, anything that doesn't fit elsewhere.
